metadata.description: A .skills collection: prompts with resources and scripts as reusable AI runtime modules.

plugins.name: codebase-memory-mcp
plugins.description: Bring up `codebase-memory-mcp` for a repository and prove the graph is usable before relying on it for code discovery.

plugins.name: codex-goal-mining
plugins.description: Recover structured Codex goal history and convert free-form runs into evidence-backed, repeatable suites.

plugins.name: codex-session-recovery
plugins.description: Recover crashed, detached, or confusing agent sessions while preserving the best restore source.

plugins.name: crabpot-perf-metrics
plugins.description: Turn Crabpot/OpenClaw perf artifacts into a clear read: what changed, what is real signal, what is stale/noisy, and what action is worth taking.

plugins.name: crawlkit
plugins.description: Maintain crawlkit, the shared Go library for crawl app archive infrastructure.

plugins.name: ghcrawl-cluster-operator
plugins.description: Operate ghcrawl as a local-first GitHub issue and pull request crawler: inspect the SQLite store, pull GitHub data, refresh summaries and embeddings, build clusters, and extract cluster evidence through deterministic CLI commands.

plugins.name: graincrawl
plugins.description: Maintain `graincrawl`, the Go CLI that archives Granola notes, transcripts,

plugins.name: openclaw-github-dedupe
plugins.description: Use this skill when a cluster of GitHub issues and pull requests has been reported for a common failure mode (Slack, iMessage, support threads, or manual list), and you need an evidence-based dedupe recommendation, execution pass, or autonomous closeout run.

plugins.name: operations-worktree
plugins.description: Create and manage worktrees safely and consistently across projects while avoiding stale branch bases.

plugins.name: opik-integrations-auditor
plugins.description: Audit, compare, and document Opik integrations across Python, TypeScript, and backend OTEL/API surfaces with a repeatable evidence-first workflow.

plugins.name: opik-optimizer
plugins.description: Design, run, and interpret Opik Optimizer workflows for prompts, tools, and model parameters with consistent dataset/metric wiring and reproducible evaluation.

plugins.name: semantic-slicing
plugins.description: Turn a large repo into reviewable semantic slices with evidence. Use code shape, threat candidates, issue clusters, and support chatter together so review budget lands on the right parts of the system.

plugins.name: technical-deslop
plugins.description: Clean branch/staged diffs by removing AI-style slop and restoring repo-consistent style without changing behavior.

plugins.name: technical-documentation
plugins.description: Produce and review technical documentation that is clear, actionable, and maintainable for both humans and agents, including contributor-governance files and agent instruction files.

plugins.name: technical-integrations
plugins.description: Design and review external-vendor integrations using existing internal patterns, with vendor/framework-agnostic workflows for API, RFC, SDK, and rollout planning.

plugins.name: technical-skill-finder
plugins.description: Find recurring pain points from local agent logs and convert them into actionable skill candidates, reuse opportunities, or existing skill updates.

plugins.name: tmux-agent-lane-orchestrator
plugins.description: Turn a tmux window of coding-agent workers into a visible, auditable lane with clear state and next actions.
